varisWorkflow.decision: User requested reuse of the accepted Druk glove sculpts after rejecting the new Varis hand reconstructions.
varisWorkflow.source: Druk V7 actual multiview-generated glove sculpts, extracted losslessly for V8; no Druk sword reuse.
varisWorkflow.fitting: Measured nonuniform fitting at the anatomical wrist; connected proximal cuff/crease faces are trimmed, and two short internal leather overlaps close the wrist contours. Retained source vertex, normal, UV and image bytes are exact. Finger topology is retained; world proportions change through the measured transforms. The whole fitted hand is not claimed to be a rigid source copy.
varisWorkflow.selectedHandGeometryBranch: anatomical-wrist-01/candidate-01 -> candidate-06 -> candidate-07; no failed taper/recess deformation and no candidate-08 material tint. Any later rigid weapon roll is recorded by the final selection.
varisWorkflow.weapons: Selected source-guided four-view shortsword projected-04 and dagger projected-02. Full reconstructed blades/materials are retained; final fit adjustments are documented in assembly evidence.
